captions.gbp:
Nervous about a scan? Here's what recent patients shared in their Google reviews.

"Michelle is a wonderful tech who made me feel so comfortable during my MRI! She was so kind and professional. Wonderful experience!" (Christina A.)

"…She made sure everything was scheduled properly, helped me understand the costs involved, and explained what to expect… She made the whole process much easier and less stressful." (Sean D.)

"Everyone is super nice. I was able to walk right in and get an MRI within 30 minutes." (Joshua J.)

Before any scan, it helps to ask: what will my exam cost, do I need a doctor's order, how long will it take and how do I prepare, and when will my doctor get the results? Our team is happy to answer all four before you book, at our Seminole and St. Pete offices.

Book online at advancedimg.com. Individual experiences vary. General information, not medical advice.
